title: mods-n-crap reuploaded

body:
# mods-n-crap

this reuploaded cozy modpack is pure fun & relaxation. No grind, just chill vibes for solo, friends, or family!

## Features
- 50+ mods: Cute animals, tasty food, building blocks, light quests
- Smooth optimization (no lag)
- Multiplayer-ready
- New biomes & cozy exploration

Full list in Versions tab!

## Benefits
Stress-free cozy play—build homes, farm, explore easy. Beginner/family-friendly!

## Install
1. Modrinth/Prism download
2. 4-6GB RAM
3. Play & relax! ☕
